description: The services comprise implementation of an end-to-end Environmental Monitoring System for the new children's hospital, to be operated by Children's Health Ireland (CHI). As CHI prepares for the opening of the National Children’s Hospital Ireland (NCHI), the organisation has identified the need to develop a comprehensive Independent Environmental Monitoring system. This system will serve CHI at the NCHI and potentially the satellite facilities at CHI at Tallaght and CHI at Connolly. The system will be specifically for use in a hospital environment monitoring pharmacies, lab and speciality environments and Temperatures. The system must ensure compliance with suitable ISO accreditation standards and integrate with a centralised monitoring system that meets current environmental and temperature monitoring standards. Any contract award will be subject to funding approval.

title: Manufacture, Verification and Delivery of Adaptive Optics Wavefront Sensing Cameras for the Extremely Large Telescope (ELT)
description: Division: DOP. A Call for tender covering the Manufacture, according to ESO’s design, verification and delivery of different types of Wavefront Sensing Cameras for the ELT will be issued in Q2 2021. These cameras will be used for a variety of Adaptive Optics applications at the ELT, both for the telescope and its instrumentation. The cameras consist of the detector and its mount, read-out Front-End board, Main Control board, Power Regulator board, Peltier Controller/Cryostat, main structure and cooling system. The detectors types will be electron multiplying CCD and CMOS, these will be supplied by ESO. The cameras will be developed in house by ESO, after which the contract(s) will be placed by ESO for their production (built-to-print contract). The Call for tender is planned to be issued to potential suppliers in the ESO Member States and Chile, with the aim to award the contract in Q4 2021. Scheduled/Status:
